# Portable cockpit instructions

Read [the canonical contract](../AGENTS.md) before work and use
[project.yaml](../project.yaml) to identify the target. Target commands run in
its independent repository. Plans live in locally excluded target task folders;
shared knowledge and ethical evaluations remain in the cockpit.
Follow [target discovery](../docs/TARGET_WORKFLOW.md) before contribution work:
read applicable target instructions and relevant native skills alongside cockpit
skills, selecting exact file paths. Target guidance wins overlapping conflicts.
Parent instructions may be unavailable to child-only cloud tasks; do not claim
the cockpit is active there without checking its presence.
